                    </td>
                `;
                tableBody.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        async function addContact() {
            const first_name = document.getElementById('contactFirstName').value;
            const last_name = document.getElementById('contactLastName').value;
            const email = document.getElementById('contactEmail').value;
            const phone = document.getElementById('contactPhone').value;
            const title = document.getElementById('contactTitle').value;

            const response = await fetch('http://localhost:4000/api/contacts', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ account_id: null, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title })
            });

            if (response.ok) {
                loadContacts();
                const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addContactModal'));
                modal.hide();
                document.getElementById('addContactForm').reset();
            } else {
                alert('Failed to add contact');
            }
        }

        async function deleteContact(id) {
            const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:4000/api/contacts/${id}`, {
                method: 'DELETE'
            });

            if (response.ok) {
                loadContacts();
            } else {
                alert('Failed to delete contact');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

const db = require('../config/database');

// GET /api/contacts
exports.getAllContacts = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const contacts = await db.all('SELECT * FROM contacts ORDER BY id DESC');
    res.json(contacts);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

// GET /api/contacts/:id
exports.getContactById = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const contact = await db.get('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if (!contact) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }
    res.json(contact);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

// GET /api/accounts/:id/contacts
exports.getContactsByAccountId = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const accountId = req.params.id;

    const account = await db.get('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', [accountId]);
    if (!account) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Account not found' });
    }

    const contacts = await db.all('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC', [accountId]);
    res.json(contacts);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

// POST /api/contacts
exports.createContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title } = req.body;

    if (!first_name) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'first_name is required' });
    }

    const stmt = await db.prepare('INSERT INTO contacts (account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');
    const { lastID } = await stmt.run(account_id || null, first_name, last_name || null, email || null, phone || null, title || null);
    stmt.finalize();
    res.status(201).json({
      id: lastID,
      account_id: account_id || null,
      first_name,
      last_name: last_name || null,
      email: email || null,
      phone: phone || null,
      title: title || null,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

// PUT /api/contacts/:id
exports.updateContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title } = req.body;

    if (!first_name) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'first_name is required' });
    }

    const contact = await db.get('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if (!contact) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }

    const stmt = await db.prepare('UPDATE contacts SET account_id = ?, first_name = ?, last_name = ?, email = ?, phone = ?, title = ? WHERE id = ?');
    await stmt.run(account_id || contact.account_id, first_name, last_name || contact.last_name, email || contact.email, phone || contact.phone, title || contact.title, req.params.id);
    stmt.finalize();
    res.json({
      id: Number(req.params.id),
      account_id: account_id || contact.account_id,
      first_name,
      last_name: last_name || contact.last_name,
      email: email || contact.email,
      phone: phone || contact.phone,
      title: title || contact.title,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

// DELETE /api/contacts/:id
exports.deleteContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const stmt = await db.prepare('DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ?');
    const result = await stmt.run(req.params.id);
    if (result.changes === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }
    res.json({ message: 'Contact deleted' });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

    res.json({ message: 'Contact deleted' });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message });
  }
};

const db = require('../config/database');

// GET /api/contacts
exports.getAllContacts = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const contacts = await db.all('SELECT * FROM contacts ORDER BY id DESC');
    res.json(contacts);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// GET /api/contacts/:id
exports.getContactById = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const contact = await db.get('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if (!contact) {

    }
    res.json(contact);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// GET /api/accounts/:id/contacts
exports.getContactsByAccountId = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const accountId = req.params.id;

    const account = await db.get('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', [accountId]);
    if (!account) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Account not found' });
    }

    const contacts = await db.all('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC', [accountId]);
    res.json(contacts);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// POST /api/contacts
exports.createContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title } = req.body;

    if (!account_id || !first_name) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'account_id and first_name are required' });
    }

    const account = await db.get('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', [account_id]);
    if (!account) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Account not found' });
    }

    const stmt = await db.prepare('INSERT INTO contacts (account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');
    const { lastID } = await stmt.run(account_id, first_name, last_name || null, email || null, phone || null, title || null);
    stmt.finalize();
    res.status(201).json({
      id: lastID,
      account_id,
      first_name,
      last_name: last_name || null,
      email: email || null,
      phone: phone || null,
      title: title || null,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// PUT /api/contacts/:id
exports.updateContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { account_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, title } = req.body;

    if (!first_name) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'first_name is required' });
    }

    const contact = await db.get('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if (!contact) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }

    const newAccountId = account_id || contact.account_id;

    const account = await db.get('SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', [newAccountId]);
    if (!account) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Account not found' });
    }

    const stmt = await db.prepare('UPDATE contacts SET account_id = ?, first_name = ?, last_name = ?, email = ?, phone = ?, title = ? WHERE id = ?');
    await stmt.run(newAccountId, first_name, last_name || null, email || null, phone || null, title || null, req.params.id);
    stmt.finalize();
    res.json({
      id: Number(req.params.id),
      account_id: newAccountId,
      first_name,
      last_name: last_name || null,
      email: email || null,
      phone: phone || null,
      title: title || null,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// DELETE /api/contacts/:id
exports.deleteContact = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const stmt = await db.prepare('DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ?');
    const result = await stmt.run(req.params.id);
    if (result.changes === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }
    res.json({ message: 'Contact deleted' });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

// GET /api/contacts/:id
exports.getContactById = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const contact = await db.get('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
    if (!contact) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contact not found' });
    }
    res.json(contact);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
};

### src/config/database.js
```javascript
const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

const dataDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'data');
if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });
}

const dbPath = path.join(dataDir, 'app.db');

const db = new sqlite3.Database(dbPath, (err) => {
  if (err) {
    console.error('Error opening database:', err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('Connected to SQLite database');
});

db.serialize(() => {
  db.run('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
  db.run('PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF');

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      industry TEXT,
      phone TEXT,
      website TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contacts (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      account_id INTEGER,
      first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_name TEXT,
      email TEXT,
      phone TEXT,
      title TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS opportunities (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      account_id INTEGER,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      amount REAL,
      stage TEXT CHECK (stage IN ('Prospecting', 'Qualification', 'Proposal', 'Closed Won', 'Closed Lost')),
      close_date TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      price REAL,
      description TEXT,
      is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deals (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      amount REAL,
      stage TEXT CHECK (stage IN ('Prospecting', 'Qualification', 'Proposal', 'Closed Won', 'Closed Lost')),
      account_id INTEGER,
      contact_id INTEGER,
      close_date TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (contact_id) REFERENCES contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leads (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_name TEXT,
      company TEXT,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'New',
      email TEXT,
      phone TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );
  `);

  // New tables for Phase 4
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cases (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      account_id INTEGER,
      contact_id INTEGER,
      subject TEXT,
      priority TEXT,
      status TEXT,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (contact_id) REFERENCES contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    );
  `);

  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      title TEXT,
      due_date TEXT,
      status TEXT,
      deal_id INTEGER,
      account_id INTEGER,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (deal_id) REFERENCES deals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    );
  `);
});

module.exports = db;
```

### src/controllers/caseController.js
```javascript
const db = require('../config/database');

const getCases = async () => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all('SELECT * FROM cases', (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        reject(err);
      } else {
        resolve(rows);
      }
    });
  });
};

const getCaseById = async (id) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get('SELECT * FROM cases WHERE id = ?', [id], (err, row) => {
      if (err) {
        reject(err);
      } else {
        resolve(row);
      }
    });
  });
};

const createCase = async (caseData) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run('INSERT INTO cases (account_id, contact_id, subject, priority, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', 
      [caseData.account_id, caseData.contact_id, caseData.subject, caseData.priority, caseData.status], 
      function(err) {
        if (err) {
          reject(err);
        } else {
          resolve({ id: this.lastID });
        }
      });
  });
};

const updateCase = async (id, caseData) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run('UPDATE cases SET account_id = ?, contact_id = ?, subject = ?, priority = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?', 
      [caseData.account_id, caseData.contact_id, caseData.subject, caseData.priority, caseData.status, id], 
      function(err) {
        if (err) {
          reject(err);
        } else {
          resolve({ id: this.changes });
        }
      });
  });
};

const deleteCase = async (id) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run('DELETE FROM cases WHERE id = ?', [id], function(err) {
      if (err) {
        reject(err);
      } else {
        resolve({ id: this.changes });
      }
    });
  });
};

module.exports = {
  getCases,
  getCaseById,
  createCase,
  updateCase,
  deleteCase,
};
```

### src/routes/caseRoutes.js
```javascript
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const caseController = require('../controllers/caseController');

router.get('/', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const cases = await caseController.getCases();
    res.json(cases);
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

router.get('/:id', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const caseData = await caseController.getCaseById(req.params.id);
    if (caseData) {
      res.json(caseData);
    } else {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

router.post('/', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const caseData = req.body;
    const newCase = await caseController.createCase(caseData);
    res.status(201).json(newCase);
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

router.put('/:id', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const caseData = req.body;
    const updatedCase = await caseController.updateCase(req.params.id, caseData);
    if (updatedCase) {
      res.json(updatedCase);
    } else {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

router.delete('/:id', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const deletedCase = await caseController.deleteCase(req.params.id);
    if (deletedCase) {
      res.json(deletedCase);
    } else {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;
```

```javascript
    if (deletedTask) {
      res.json(deletedTask);
    } else {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Task not found' });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;
```

```html
      document.getElementById('tasks-content').classList.remove('d-none');
      loadTasks();
    });

    document.getElementById('saveCase').addEventListener('click', function() {
      const caseData = {
        account: document.getElementById('account').value,
        contact: document.getElementById('contact').value,
        subject: document.getElementById('subject').value,
        priority: document.getElementById('priority').value,
        status: document.getElementById('status').value
      };

      fetch('/api/cases', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(caseData)
      })
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Success',
          text: 'Case added successfully!'
        });
        document.getElementById('caseForm').reset();
        loadCases();
      })
      .catch(error => {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'error',
          title: 'Error',
          text: 'Failed to add case!'
        });
      });
    });

    document.getElementById('saveTask').addEventListener('click', function() {
      const taskData = {
        title: document.getElementById('title').value,
        due_date: document.getElementById('due_date').value,
        status: document.getElementById('status').value,
        deal: document.getElementById('deal').value,
        account: document.getElementById('account').value
      };

      fetch('/api/tasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(taskData)
      })
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Success',
          text: 'Task added successfully!'
        });
        document.getElementById('taskForm').reset();
        loadTasks();
      })
      .catch(error => {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'error',
          title: 'Error',
          text: 'Failed to add task!'
        });
      });
    });

    function loadCases() {
      fetch('/api/cases')
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
          const tableBody = document.getElementById('cases-table');
          tableBody.innerHTML = '';
          data.forEach(caseItem => {
            const row = document.createElement('tr');
            row.innerHTML = `
              <td>${caseItem.id}</td>
              <td>${caseItem.account_id}</td>
              <td>${caseItem.contact_id}</td>
              <td>${caseItem.subject}</td>
              <td>${caseItem.priority}</td>
              <td>${caseItem.status}</td>
              <td>
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="editCase(${caseItem.id})">Edit</button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteCase(${caseItem.id})">Delete</button>
              </td>
            `;
            tableBody.appendChild(row);
          });
        })
        .catch(error => {
          console.error('Error fetching cases:', error);
        });
    }

    function loadTasks() {
      fetch('/api/tasks')
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
          const tableBody = document.getElementById('tasks-table');
          tableBody.innerHTML = '';
          data.forEach(taskItem => {
            const row = document.createElement('tr');
            row.innerHTML = `
              <td>${taskItem.id}</td>
              <td>${taskItem.title}</td>
              <td>${taskItem.due_date}</td>
              <td>${taskItem.status}</td>
              <td>${taskItem.deal_id}</td>
              <td>${taskItem.account_id}</td>
              <td>
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="editTask(${taskItem.id})">Edit</button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteTask(${taskItem.id})">Delete</button>
              </td>
            `;
            tableBody.appendChild(row);
          });
        })
        .catch(error => {
          console.error('Error fetching tasks:', error);
        });
    }

    function editCase(id) {
      // Implement edit case logic here
    }

    function deleteCase(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Are you sure?',
        text: 'You won\'t be able to revert this!',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#3085d6',
        cancelButtonColor: '#d33',
        confirmButtonText: 'Yes, delete it!'
      }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
          fetch(`/api/cases/${id}`, {
            method: 'DELETE'
          })
          .then(response => response.json())
          .then(data => {
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'success',
              title: 'Success',
              text: 'Case deleted successfully!'
            });
            loadCases();
          })
          .catch(error => {
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'error',
              title: 'Error',
              text: 'Failed to delete case!'
            });
          });
        }
      });
    }

    function editTask(id) {
      // Implement edit task logic here
    }

    function deleteTask(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Are you sure?',
        text: 'You won\'t be able to revert this!',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#3085d6',
        cancelButtonColor: '#d33',
        confirmButtonText: 'Yes, delete it!'
      }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
          fetch(`/api/tasks/${id}`, {
            method: 'DELETE'
          })
          .then(response => response.json())
          .then(data => {
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'success',
              title: 'Success',
              text: 'Task deleted successfully!'
            });
            loadTasks();
          })
          .catch(error => {
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'error',
              title: 'Error',
              text: 'Failed to delete task!'
            });
          });
        }
      });
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/deals');

        async function deleteAccount(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/accounts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadAccounts(); }

        }
        async function deleteContact(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/contacts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadContacts(); }

        async function deleteProduct(id) {

        async function loadLeads() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/leads');
                const result = await res.json();
                const leads = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadLeads data:', leads);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('leadsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = leads.map(item => `
                    <tr>

                        <td>${item.status === 'Converted' ? '<span class="badge bg-success">Converted</span>' : `<span class="badge bg-secondary">${fmt(item.status)}</span>`}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>

                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="convertLead(${item.id})" ${item.status === 'Converted' ? 'disabled' : ''}>Convert to Opportunity</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteLead(${item.id})">Delete</button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadLeads Error:', e); }
        }
        async function convertLead(id) {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'แปลง Lead เป็น Opportunity',
                text: 'ระบบจะสร้าง Account, Contact และ Deal จาก Lead นี้อัตโนมัติ',
                icon: 'info',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
            });
            if (!isConfirmed) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}/convert`, { method: 'POST' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('แปลงข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('แปลงข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteLead(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function addLead() {
            const body = {
                first_name: document.getElementById('leadFirstName').value,
                last_name: document.getElementById('leadLastName').value,
                company: document.getElementById('leadCompany').value,
                email: document.getElementById('leadEmail').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('leadPhone').value,
                status: document.getElementById('leadStatus').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/leads', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadLeads();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addLeadModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addLeadForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        // ===== Deals Pipeline (Sales Analytics + Kanban Board) =====
        const DEAL_STAGES = ['Prospecting', 'Qualification', 'Proposal', 'Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'];
        let dealsView = 'table';
        let dealsCache = [];
        let draggedDealId = null;
        function setDealsView(view) {
            dealsView = view;
            document.getElementById('dealsTableView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'kanban');
            document.getElementById('dealsTableViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kanban');
            if (view === 'kanban') renderKanban(filteredDeals());
        }
        function updateDealsAnalytics(deals) {
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            const total = list.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
            const won = list.filter(d => d.stage === 'Closed Won').length;
            const winRate = list.length ? (won / list.length) * 100 : 0;
            document.getElementById('statTotalAmount').textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            document.getElementById('statWinRate').textContent = winRate.toFixed(1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('statDealCount').textContent = list.length;
        }
        function renderKanban(deals) {
            const board = document.getElementById('kanbanBoard');
            if (!board) return;
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            board.innerHTML = DEAL_STAGES.map(stage => {
                const items = list.filter(d => d.stage === stage);
                const sum = items.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
                const cards = items.map(kanbanCard).join('') || '<div class="text-muted small px-1">—</div>';
                return `
                    <div class="kanban-col" data-stage="${stage}" ondragover="onKanbanDragOver(event)" ondragleave="onKanbanDragLeave(event)" ondrop="onKanbanDrop(event, '${stage}')">
                        <div class="kanban-col-header"><span>${stage}</span><span class="badge bg-dark">${items.length}</span></div>
                        <div class="kanban-col-body">${cards}</div>
                        <div class="text-muted small mt-2">รวม: ${sum.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        function kanbanCard(d) {
            const amount = (d.amount === null || d.amount === undefined) ? '-' : Number(d.amount).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            const options = DEAL_STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === d.stage ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');
            return `
                <div class="kanban-card" draggable="true" data-deal-id="${d.id}" ondragstart="onKanbanDragStart(event, ${d.id})" ondragend="onKanbanDragEnd(event)">
                    <div class="fw-semibold">${fmt(d.title)}</div>
                    <div class="deal-amount">${amount}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">#${d.id} • ปิด: ${fmt(d.close_date)}</div>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm kanban-stage-select mt-2" onchange="changeDealStage(${d.id}, this.value)">${options}</select>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        function onKanbanDragStart(e, id) {
            draggedDealId = id;
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(id));
        }
        function onKanbanDragEnd(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-col.drag-over').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
        }
        function onKanbanDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
        }
        function onKanbanDragLeave(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
        async function onKanbanDrop(e, stage) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
            let id = draggedDealId;
            if (id === null || id === undefined) {
                const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
                id = raw ? Number(raw) : NaN;
            }
            draggedDealId = null;
            if (!id) return;
            await changeDealStage(id, stage);
        }
        async function changeDealStage(id, stage) {
            if (!DEAL_STAGES.includes(stage)) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/deals/${id}/stage`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ stage })
                });
                if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('อัปเดต Stage สำเร็จ'); }
                else { toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ'); }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('changeDealStage Error:', e);
                toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
            loadDeals();
        }
        // ===== Deals Filters (Account / Close date range) + Export CSV =====
        let dealsFilter = { account: '', from: '', to: '' };
        function populateDealAccountFilter(accounts) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount');
            if (!sel) return;
            const current = sel.value;
            const opts = ['<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>'].concat(
                (accounts || []).map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${fmt(a.name)} (#${a.id})</option>`)
            );
            sel.innerHTML = opts.join('');
            if (current) sel.value = current;
        }
        function filteredDeals() {
            return dealsCache.filter(d => {
                if (dealsFilter.account !== '' && String(d.account_id) !== String(dealsFilter.account)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.from && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) < dealsFilter.from)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.to && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) > dealsFilter.to)) return false;
                return true;
            });
        }
        function applyDealFilters() {
            dealsFilter.account = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value;
            dealsFilter.from = document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value;
            dealsFilter.to = document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value;
            renderDeals();
        }
        function resetDealFilters() {
            document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value = '';
            applyDealFilters();
        }
        function renderDeals() {
            const list = filteredDeals();
            updateDealsAnalytics(list);
            if (dealsView === 'kanban') renderKanban(list);
            const tbody = document.getElementById('dealsTable');
            if (!tbody) return;
            tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                <tr>
                    <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.amount)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.stage)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.account_id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.contact_id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.close_date)}</td>
                    <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteDeal(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }
        function exportPipeline() {
            const list = filteredDeals();
            if (!list.length) { toastError('ไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับ export'); return; }
            const headers = ['ID', 'Title', 'Amount', 'Stage', 'Account ID', 'Contact ID', 'Close Date'];
            const esc = (v) => '"' + ((v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v)).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
            const rows = list.map(d => [d.id, d.title, d.amount, d.stage, d.account_id, d.contact_id, d.close_date].map(esc).join(','));
            const csv = [headers.map(esc).join(',')].concat(rows).join('\r\n');
            const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = 'deals-pipeline-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            toastSuccess('Export pipeline สำเร็จ');
        }
    </script>
</body>

            <div class="tab-pane fade" id="deals" role="tabpanel">
                <h2 class="mt-3">Deals</h2>
                <!-- Sales Analytics Bar -->
                <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
                    <div class="col-md-4">
                        <div class="card border-primary h-100"><div class="card-body py-3">
                            <div class="text-muted small">Total Pipeline Amount</div>
                            <div class="fs-4 fw-bold" id="statTotalAmount">-</div>

                        </div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4">
                        <div class="card border-secondary h-100"><div class="card-body py-3">
                            <div class="text-muted small">จำนวน Deals</div>
                            <div class="fs-4 fw-bold" id="statDealCount">-</div>
                        </div></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <!-- Deals Filters + Export -->
                <div class="row g-2 align-items-end mb-3">
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Account</label>
                        <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="dealFilterAccount" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                            <option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Close Date (จาก)</label>
                        <input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="dealFilterFrom" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Close Date (ถึง)</label>
                        <input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="dealFilterTo" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3 d-flex gap-2">

                    </div>

                    <div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Deals view toggle">
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary active" id="dealsTableViewBtn" onclick="setDealsView('table')">Table View</button>
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="dealsKanbanViewBtn" onclick="setDealsView('kanban')">Kanban View</button>
                    </div>

                <!-- Table View -->

                        </thead>

                <!-- Kanban View -->

                    <div class="text-muted small mb-2">ลากการ์ดเพื่อย้าย Stage หรือเลือก Stage จาก dropdown บนการ์ดได้เลย</div>

                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>

                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addCaseForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="caseTitle" required></div>

                            <label class="form-label">Stage</label>

                </div>

    <!-- Add Task Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addTaskModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Task</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addTaskForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="taskTitle" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Description</label><textarea class="form-control" id="taskDescription"></textarea></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Due Date</label><input type="date" class="form-control" id="taskDueDate"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Assigned To</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="taskAssignedTo"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="taskStatus">
                                <option value="Pending">Pending</option>
                                <option value="Completed">Completed</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addTask()">Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadAccounts();
            loadContacts();
            loadProducts();
            loadDeals();
            loadCases();
            loadTasks();
        });
        // แสดงผลค่า null / undefined เป็นเครื่องหมาย -
        const fmt = (val) => (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') ? '-' : val;
        // SweetAlert2 helpers (toast + confirm)
        const toast = Swal.mixin({
            toast: true,
            position: 'top-end',
            showConfirmButton: false,
            timer: 1600,
            timerProgressBar: true,
        });
        const toastSuccess = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title });
        const toastError = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'error', title });
        async function confirmDelete() {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'คุณต้องการลบข้อมูลนี้ใช่หรือไม่?',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                cancelButtonColor: '#6c757d',
                reverseButtons: true,
            });
            return isConfirmed;
        }
        async function loadAccounts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/accounts');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                populateDealAccountFilter(list);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('accountsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.industry)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.website)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteAccount(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadAccounts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadContacts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/contacts');
                const result = await res.json();
                const contacts = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadContacts data:', contacts);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('contactsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = contacts.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.first_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.last_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteContact(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadContacts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadProducts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/products');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('productsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.code)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.price)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                        <td>${item.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteProduct(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadProducts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadDeals() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/deals');
                const result = await res.json();
                const deals = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadDeals data:', deals);
                dealsCache = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
                renderDeals();
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadDeals Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadCases() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/cases');
                const result = await res.json();
                const cases = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadCases data:', cases);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('casesTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = cases.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.stage)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.assigned_to)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.close_date)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteCase(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadCases Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadTasks() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/tasks');
                const result = await res.json();
                const tasks = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadTasks data:', tasks);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('tasksTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = tasks.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.due_date)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.assigned_to)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.status)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteTask(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadTasks Error:', e); }
        }
        async function addAccount() {
            const body = {
                name: document.getElementById('accountName').value,
                industry: document.getElementById('accountIndustry').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('accountPhone').value,
                website: document.getElementById('accountWebsite').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/accounts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadAccounts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addAccountModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addAccountForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addContact() {
            const body = {
                first_name: document.getElementById('contactFirstName').value,
                last_name: document.getElementById('contactLastName').value,
                email: document.getElementById('contactEmail').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('contactPhone').value,
                title: document.getElementById('contactTitle').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/contacts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadContacts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addContactModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addContactForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addProduct() {
            const body = {
                name: document.getElementById('productName').value,
                code: document.getElementById('productCode').value,
                price: document.getElementById('productPrice').value,
                description: document.getElementById('productDescription').value,
                is_active: document.getElementById('productIsActive').value === 'true'
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/products', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadProducts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addProductModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addProductForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addDeal() {
            const body = {
                title: document.getElementById('dealTitle').value,
                amount: document.getElementById('dealAmount').value,
                stage: document.getElementById('dealStage').value,
                close_date: document.getElementById('dealCloseDate').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/deals', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadDeals();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addDealModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addDealForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addCase() {
            const body = {
                title: document.getElementById('caseTitle').value,
                description: document.getElementById('caseDescription').value,
                stage: document.getElementById('caseStage').value,
                assigned_to: document.getElementById('caseAssignedTo').value,
                close_date: document.getElementById('caseCloseDate').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/cases', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadCases();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addCaseModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addCaseForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addTask() {
            const body = {
                title: document.getElementById('taskTitle').value,
                description: document.getElementById('taskDescription').value,
                due_date: document.getElementById('taskDueDate').value,
                assigned_to: document.getElementById('taskAssignedTo').value,
                status: document.getElementById('taskStatus').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/tasks', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadTasks();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addTaskModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addTaskForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function deleteAccount(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/accounts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadAccounts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteContact(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/contacts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadContacts(); }
```

                        <div class="card border-success h-100"><div class="card-body py-3">
                            <div class="text-muted small">Win Rate (Closed Won)</div>
                            <div class="fs-4 fw-bold" id="statWinRate">-</div>
                        </div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4">
                        <div class="card border-secondary h-100"><div class="card-body py-3">
                            <div class="text-muted small">จำนวน Deals</div>
                            <div class="fs-4 fw-bold" id="statDealCount">-</div>
                        </div></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <!-- Deals Filters + Export -->
                <div class="row g-2 align-items-end mb-3">
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Account</label>
                        <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="dealFilterAccount" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                            <option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Close Date (จาก)</label>
                        <input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="dealFilterFrom" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <label class="form-label small mb-1">Close Date (ถึง)</label>
                        <input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="dealFilterTo" onchange="applyDealFilters()">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3 d-flex gap-2">
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary flex-fill" onclick="resetDealFilters()">ล้างตัวกรอง</button>
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-success flex-fill" onclick="exportPipeline()">Export CSV</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3 flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#addDealModal">Add Deal</button>
                    <div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Deals view toggle">
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary active" id="dealsTableViewBtn" onclick="setDealsView('table')">Table View</button>
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="dealsKanbanViewBtn" onclick="setDealsView('kanban')">Kanban View</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <!-- Table View -->
                <div id="dealsTableView">
                    <table class="table table-bordered table-striped">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>ID</th>
                                <th>Title</th>
                                <th>Amount</th>
                                <th>Stage</th>
                                <th>Account ID</th>
                                <th>Contact ID</th>
                                <th>Close Date</th>
                                <th>Actions</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="dealsTable"></tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
                <!-- Kanban View -->
                <div id="dealsKanbanView" class="d-none">
                    <div class="text-muted small mb-2">ลากการ์ดเพื่อย้าย Stage หรือเลือก Stage จาก dropdown บนการ์ดได้เลย</div>
                    <div class="kanban-board" id="kanbanBoard"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Add Account Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addAccountModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Account</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addAccountForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Name</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="accountName" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Industry</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="accountIndustry"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Phone</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="accountPhone"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Website</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="accountWebsite"></div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addAccount()">Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Add Lead Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addLeadModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Lead</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addLeadForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">First Name *</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="leadFirstName" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Last Name</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="leadLastName"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Company</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="leadCompany"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Email</label><input type="email" class="form-control" id="leadEmail"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Phone</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="leadPhone"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="leadStatus">

                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addLead()">Add</button>
                </div>

        </div>

    <!-- Add Contact Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addContactModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Contact</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addContactForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">First Name *</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="contactFirstName" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Last Name</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="contactLastName"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Email</label><input type="email" class="form-control" id="contactEmail"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Phone</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="contactPhone"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="contactTitle"></div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addContact()">Add</button>
