    <!-- Add Product Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addProductModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Product</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addProductForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Name</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="productName" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Code</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="productCode" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Price</label><input type="number" class="form-control" id="productPrice"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Description</label><textarea class="form-control" id="productDescription"></textarea></div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Is Active</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="productIsActive">
                                <option value="true">Yes</option>
                                <option value="false">No</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addProduct()">Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Add Deal Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="addDealModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Deal</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addDealForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title *</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="dealTitle" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Amount *</label><input type="number" class="form-control" id="dealAmount" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Stage *</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="dealStage" required>
                                <option value="Prospecting">Prospecting</option>
                                <option value="Qualification">Qualification</option>
                                <option value="Proposal">Proposal</option>
                                <option value="Closed Won">Closed Won</option>
                                <option value="Closed Lost">Closed Lost</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Close Date</label><input type="date" class="form-control" id="dealCloseDate"></div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addDeal()">Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadAccounts();
            loadContacts();
            loadProducts();
            loadDeals();
            loadLeads();
        });
        // แสดงผลค่า null / undefined เป็นเครื่องหมาย -
        const fmt = (val) => (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') ? '-' : val;
        // SweetAlert2 helpers (toast + confirm)
        const toast = Swal.mixin({
            toast: true,
            position: 'top-end',
            showConfirmButton: false,
            timer: 1600,
            timerProgressBar: true,
        });
        const toastSuccess = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title });
        const toastError = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'error', title });
        async function confirmDelete() {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'คุณต้องการลบข้อมูลนี้ใช่หรือไม่?',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                cancelButtonColor: '#6c757d',
                reverseButtons: true,
            });
            return isConfirmed;
        }
        async function loadAccounts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/accounts');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                populateDealAccountFilter(list);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('accountsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.industry)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.website)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteAccount(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadAccounts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadContacts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/contacts');
                const result = await res.json();
                const contacts = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadContacts data:', contacts);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('contactsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = contacts.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.first_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.last_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteContact(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadContacts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadProducts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/products');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('productsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.code)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.price)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                        <td>${item.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteProduct(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadProducts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadDeals() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/deals');
                const result = await res.json();
                const deals = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadDeals data:', deals);
                dealsCache = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
                renderDeals();
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadDeals Error:', e); }
        }
        async function addAccount() {
            const body = {
                name: document.getElementById('accountName').value,
                industry: document.getElementById('accountIndustry').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('accountPhone').value,
                website: document.getElementById('accountWebsite').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/accounts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadAccounts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addAccountModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addAccountForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addContact() {
            const body = {
                first_name: document.getElementById('contactFirstName').value,
                last_name: document.getElementById('contactLastName').value,
                email: document.getElementById('contactEmail').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('contactPhone').value,
                title: document.getElementById('contactTitle').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/contacts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadContacts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addContactModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addContactForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addProduct() {
            const body = {
                name: document.getElementById('productName').value,
                code: document.getElementById('productCode').value,
                price: document.getElementById('productPrice').value,
                description: document.getElementById('productDescription').value,
                is_active: document.getElementById('productIsActive').value === 'true'
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/products', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadProducts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addProductModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addProductForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function addDeal() {
            const body = {
                title: document.getElementById('dealTitle').value,
                amount: document.getElementById('dealAmount').value,
                stage: document.getElementById('dealStage').value,
                close_date: document.getElementById('dealCloseDate').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/deals', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadDeals();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addDealModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addDealForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        async function deleteAccount(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/accounts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadAccounts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteContact(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/contacts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadContacts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteProduct(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadProducts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteDeal(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/deals/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadDeals(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function loadLeads() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/leads');
                const result = await res.json();
                const leads = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadLeads data:', leads);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('leadsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = leads.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.first_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.last_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.company)}</td>
                        <td>${item.status === 'Converted' ? '<span class="badge bg-success">Converted</span>' : `<span class="badge bg-secondary">${fmt(item.status)}</span>`}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="convertLead(${item.id})" ${item.status === 'Converted' ? 'disabled' : ''}>Convert to Opportunity</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteLead(${item.id})">Delete</button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadLeads Error:', e); }
        }
        async function convertLead(id) {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'แปลง Lead เป็น Opportunity',
                text: 'ระบบจะสร้าง Account, Contact และ Deal จาก Lead นี้อัตโนมัติ',
                icon: 'info',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
            });
            if (!isConfirmed) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}/convert`, { method: 'POST' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('แปลงข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('แปลงข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteLead(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function addLead() {
            const body = {
                first_name: document.getElementById('leadFirstName').value,
                last_name: document.getElementById('leadLastName').value,
                company: document.getElementById('leadCompany').value,
                email: document.getElementById('leadEmail').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('leadPhone').value,
                status: document.getElementById('leadStatus').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/leads', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadLeads();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addLeadModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addLeadForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        // ===== Deals Pipeline (Sales Analytics + Kanban Board) =====
        const DEAL_STAGES = ['Prospecting', 'Qualification', 'Proposal', 'Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'];
        let dealsView = 'table';
        let dealsCache = [];
        let draggedDealId = null;
        function setDealsView(view) {
            dealsView = view;
            document.getElementById('dealsTableView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'kanban');
            document.getElementById('dealsTableViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kanban');
            if (view === 'kanban') renderKanban(filteredDeals());
        }
        function updateDealsAnalytics(deals) {
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            const total = list.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
            const won = list.filter(d => d.stage === 'Closed Won').length;
            const winRate = list.length ? (won / list.length) * 100 : 0;
            document.getElementById('statTotalAmount').textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            document.getElementById('statWinRate').textContent = winRate.toFixed(1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('statDealCount').textContent = list.length;
        }
        function renderKanban(deals) {
            const board = document.getElementById('kanbanBoard');
            if (!board) return;
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            board.innerHTML = DEAL_STAGES.map(stage => {
                const items = list.filter(d => d.stage === stage);
                const sum = items.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
                const cards = items.map(kanbanCard).join('') || '<div class="text-muted small px-1">—</div>';
                return `
                    <div class="kanban-col" data-stage="${stage}" ondragover="onKanbanDragOver(event)" ondragleave="onKanbanDragLeave(event)" ondrop="onKanbanDrop(event, '${stage}')">
                        <div class="kanban-col-header"><span>${stage}</span><span class="badge bg-dark">${items.length}</span></div>
                        <div class="kanban-col-body">${cards}</div>
                        <div class="text-muted small mt-2">รวม: ${sum.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        function kanbanCard(d) {
            const amount = (d.amount === null || d.amount === undefined) ? '-' : Number(d.amount).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            const options = DEAL_STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === d.stage ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');
            return `
                <div class="kanban-card" draggable="true" data-deal-id="${d.id}" ondragstart="onKanbanDragStart(event, ${d.id})" ondragend="onKanbanDragEnd(event)">
                    <div class="fw-semibold">${fmt(d.title)}</div>
                    <div class="deal-amount">${amount}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">#${d.id} • ปิด: ${fmt(d.close_date)}</div>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm kanban-stage-select mt-2" onchange="changeDealStage(${d.id}, this.value)">${options}</select>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        function onKanbanDragStart(e, id) {
            draggedDealId = id;
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(id));
        }
        function onKanbanDragEnd(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-col.drag-over').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
        }
        function onKanbanDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
        }
        function onKanbanDragLeave(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
        async function onKanbanDrop(e, stage) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
            let id = draggedDealId;
            if (id === null || id === undefined) {
                const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
                id = raw ? Number(raw) : NaN;
            }
            draggedDealId = null;
            if (!id) return;
            await changeDealStage(id, stage);
        }
        async function changeDealStage(id, stage) {
            if (!DEAL_STAGES.includes(stage)) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/deals/${id}/stage`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ stage })
                });
                if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('อัปเดต Stage สำเร็จ'); }
                else { toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ'); }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('changeDealStage Error:', e);
                toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
            loadDeals();
        }
        // ===== Deals Filters (Account / Close date range) + Export CSV =====
        let dealsFilter = { account: '', from: '', to: '' };
        function populateDealAccountFilter(accounts) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount');
            if (!sel) return;
            const current = sel.value;
            const opts = ['<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>'].concat(
                (accounts || []).map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${fmt(a.name)} (#${a.id})</option>`)
            );
            sel.innerHTML = opts.join('');
            if (current) sel.value = current;
        }
        function filteredDeals() {
            return dealsCache.filter(d => {
                if (dealsFilter.account !== '' && String(d.account_id) !== String(dealsFilter.account)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.from && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) < dealsFilter.from)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.to && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) > dealsFilter.to)) return false;
                return true;
            });
        }
        function applyDealFilters() {
            dealsFilter.account = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value;
            dealsFilter.from = document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value;
            dealsFilter.to = document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value;
            renderDeals();
        }
        function resetDealFilters() {
            document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value = '';
            applyDealFilters();
        }
        function renderDeals() {
            const list = filteredDeals();
            updateDealsAnalytics(list);
            if (dealsView === 'kanban') renderKanban(list);
            const tbody = document.getElementById('dealsTable');
            if (!tbody) return;
            tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                <tr>
                    <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.amount)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.stage)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.account_id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.contact_id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.close_date)}</td>
                    <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteDeal(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }
        function exportPipeline() {
            const list = filteredDeals();
            if (!list.length) { toastError('ไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับ export'); return; }
            const headers = ['ID', 'Title', 'Amount', 'Stage', 'Account ID', 'Contact ID', 'Close Date'];
            const esc = (v) => '"' + ((v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v)).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
            const rows = list.map(d => [d.id, d.title, d.amount, d.stage, d.account_id, d.contact_id, d.close_date].map(esc).join(','));
            const csv = [headers.map(esc).join(',')].concat(rows).join('\r\n');
            const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = 'deals-pipeline-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            toastSuccess('Export pipeline สำเร็จ');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                    <h5 class="modal-title">Add Task</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addTaskForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="taskTitle" required></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Description</label><textarea class="form-control" id="taskDescription"></textarea></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Due Date</label><input type="date" class="form-control" id="taskDueDate"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Assigned To</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="taskAssignedTo"></div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="taskStatus">
                                <option value="Pending">Pending</option>
                                <option value="Completed">Completed</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addTask()">Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadAccounts();
            loadContacts();
            loadProducts();
            loadDeals();
            loadCases();
            loadTasks();
        });
        // แสดงผลค่า null / undefined เป็นเครื่องหมาย -
        const fmt = (val) => (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') ? '-' : val;
        // SweetAlert2 helpers (toast + confirm)
        const toast = Swal.mixin({
            toast: true,
            position: 'top-end',
            showConfirmButton: false,
            timer: 1600,
            timerProgressBar: true,
        });
        const toastSuccess = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title });
        const toastError = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'error', title });
        async function confirmDelete() {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'คุณต้องการลบข้อมูลนี้ใช่หรือไม่?',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                cancelButtonColor: '#6c757d',
                reverseButtons: true,
            });
            return isConfirmed;
        }
        async function loadAccounts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/accounts');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                populateDealAccountFilter(list);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('accountsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.industry)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.website)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteAccount(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadAccounts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadContacts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/contacts');
                const result = await res.json();
                const contacts = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadContacts data:', contacts);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('contactsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = contacts.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.first_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.last_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteContact(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadContacts Error:', e); }
        }
        async function loadProducts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/products');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('productsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>

        async function loadDeals() {

        async function addAccount() {
            const body = {
                name: document.getElementById('accountName').value,
                industry: document.getElementById('accountIndustry').value,

                website: document.getElementById('accountWebsite').value

            const res = await fetch('/api/accounts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });

                loadAccounts();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addAccountModal')).hide();

            };

        }
        async function deleteAccount(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/accounts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadAccounts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteContact(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/contacts/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadContacts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteProduct(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadProducts(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteDeal(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/deals/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadDeals(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteCase(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/cases/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadCases(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteTask(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadTasks(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function loadLeads() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/leads');
                const result = await res.json();
                const leads = result.data || result;
                console.log('loadLeads data:', leads);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('leadsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = leads.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.first_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.last_name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.company)}</td>
                        <td>${item.status === 'Converted' ? '<span class="badge bg-success">Converted</span>' : `<span class="badge bg-secondary">${fmt(item.status)}</span>`}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.email)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="convertLead(${item.id})" ${item.status === 'Converted' ? 'disabled' : ''}>Convert to Opportunity</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteLead(${item.id})">Delete</button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadLeads Error:', e); }
        }
        async function convertLead(id) {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'แปลง Lead เป็น Opportunity',
                text: 'ระบบจะสร้าง Account, Contact และ Deal จาก Lead นี้อัตโนมัติ',
                icon: 'info',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
            });
            if (!isConfirmed) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}/convert`, { method: 'POST' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('แปลงข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('แปลงข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function deleteLead(id) {
            if (!(await confirmDelete())) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/leads/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('ลบข้อมูลสำเร็จ'); loadLeads(); }
            else { toastError('ลบข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ'); }
        }
        async function addLead() {
            const body = {
                first_name: document.getElementById('leadFirstName').value,
                last_name: document.getElementById('leadLastName').value,
                company: document.getElementById('leadCompany').value,
                email: document.getElementById('leadEmail').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('leadPhone').value,
                status: document.getElementById('leadStatus').value
            };
            const res = await fetch('/api/leads', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
            if (res.ok) {
                loadLeads();
                bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addLeadModal')).hide();
                document.getElementById('addLeadForm').reset();
                toastSuccess('เพิ่มข้อมูลเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
            } else {
                toastError('เพิ่มข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
        }
        // ===== Cases Pipeline (Sales Analytics + Kanban Board) =====
        const CASE_STAGES = ['Open', 'In Progress', 'Closed'];
        let casesView = 'table';
        let casesCache = [];
        let draggedCaseId = null;
        function setCasesView(view) {
            casesView = view;
            document.getElementById('casesTableView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'table');
            document.getElementById('casesKanbanView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'kanban');
            document.getElementById('casesTableViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'table');
            document.getElementById('casesKanbanViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kanban');
            if (view === 'kanban') renderCases();
        }
        function updateCasesAnalytics(cases) {
            const list = Array.isArray(cases) ? cases : [];
            const open = list.filter(c => c.stage === 'Open').length;
            const inProgress = list.filter(c => c.stage === 'In Progress').length;
            const closed = list.filter(c => c.stage === 'Closed').length;
            document.getElementById('statOpenCases').textContent = open;
            document.getElementById('statInProgressCases').textContent = inProgress;
            document.getElementById('statClosedCases').textContent = closed;
        }
        function renderCases() {
            const board = document.getElementById('casesKanbanView');
            if (!board) return;
            const list = Array.isArray(casesCache) ? casesCache : [];
            board.innerHTML = CASE_STAGES.map(stage => {
                const items = list.filter(c => c.stage === stage);
                const cards = items.map(caseCard).join('') || '<div class="text-muted small px-1">—</div>';
                return `
                    <div class="kanban-col" data-stage="${stage}" ondragover="onCasesDragOver(event)" ondragleave="onCasesDragLeave(event)" ondrop="onCasesDrop(event, '${stage}')">
                        <div class="kanban-col-header"><span>${stage}</span><span class="badge bg-dark">${items.length}</span></div>
                        <div class="kanban-col-body">${cards}</div>
                        <div class="text-muted small mt-2">รวม: ${items.length}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        function caseCard(c) {
            const options = CASE_STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === c.stage ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');
            return `
                <div class="kanban-card" draggable="true" data-case-id="${c.id}" ondragstart="onCasesDragStart(event, ${c.id})" ondragend="onCasesDragEnd(event)">
                    <div class="fw-semibold">${fmt(c.title)}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">${fmt(c.description)}</div>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm kanban-stage-select mt-2" onchange="changeCaseStage(${c.id}, this.value)">${options}</select>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        function onCasesDragStart(e, id) {
            draggedCaseId = id;
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(id));
        }
        function onCasesDragEnd(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-col.drag-over').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
        }
        function onCasesDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
        }
        function onCasesDragLeave(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
        async function onCasesDrop(e, stage) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
            let id = draggedCaseId;
            if (id === null || id === undefined) {
                const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
                id = raw ? Number(raw) : NaN;
            }
            draggedCaseId = null;
            if (!id) return;
            await changeCaseStage(id, stage);
        }
        async function changeCaseStage(id, stage) {
            if (!CASE_STAGES.includes(stage)) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/cases/${id}/stage`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ stage })
                });
                if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('อัปเดต Stage สำเร็จ'); }
                else { toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ'); }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('changeCaseStage Error:', e);
                toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
            loadCases();
        }
        // ===== Cases Filters (Assigned To / Close date range) + Export CSV =====
        let casesFilter = { assignedTo: '', from: '', to: '' };
        function populateCasesAssignedToFilter(assignedTo) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilter');
            if (!sel) return;
            const current = sel.value;
            const opts = ['<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>'].concat(
                (assignedTo || []).map(a => `<option value="${a}">${fmt(a)}</option>`)
            );
            sel.innerHTML = opts.join('');
            if (current) sel.value = current;
        }
        function filteredCases() {
            return casesCache.filter(c => {
                if (casesFilter.assignedTo !== '' && String(c.assigned_to) !== String(casesFilter.assignedTo)) return false;
                if (casesFilter.from && (!c.close_date || String(c.close_date).slice(0, 10) < casesFilter.from)) return false;
                if (casesFilter.to && (!c.close_date || String(c.close_date).slice(0, 10) > casesFilter.to)) return false;
                return true;
            });
        }
        function applyCasesFilters() {
            casesFilter.assignedTo = document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilter').value;
            casesFilter.from = document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilterFrom').value;
            casesFilter.to = document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilterTo').value;
            renderCases();
        }
        function resetCasesFilters() {
            document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilter').value = '';
            document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilterFrom').value = '';
            document.getElementById('casesAssignedToFilterTo').value = '';
            applyCasesFilters();
        }
        function renderCases() {
            const list = filteredCases();
            updateCasesAnalytics(list);
            if (casesView === 'kanban') renderCases();
            const tbody = document.getElementById('casesTable');
            if (!tbody) return;
            tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                <tr>
                    <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.stage)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.assigned_to)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.close_date)}</td>
                    <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteCase(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }
        function exportCasesPipeline() {
            const list = filteredCases();
            if (!list.length) { toastError('ไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับ export'); return; }
            const headers = ['ID', 'Title', 'Description', 'Stage', 'Assigned To', 'Close Date'];
            const esc = (v) => '"' + ((v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v)).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
            const rows = list.map(c => [c.id, c.title, c.description, c.stage, c.assigned_to, c.close_date].map(esc).join(','));
            const csv = [headers.map(esc).join(',')].concat(rows).join('\r\n');
            const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = 'cases-pipeline-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            toastSuccess('Export pipeline สำเร็จ');
        }
        // ===== Tasks Pipeline (Sales Analytics + Kanban Board) =====
        const TASK_STAGES = ['Pending', 'Completed'];
        let tasksView = 'table';
        let tasksCache = [];
        let draggedTaskId = null;
        function setTasksView(view) {
            tasksView = view;
            document.getElementById('tasksTableView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'table');
            document.getElementById('tasksKanbanView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'kanban');
            document.getElementById('tasksTableViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'table');
            document.getElementById('tasksKanbanViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kanban');
            if (view === 'kanban') renderTasks();
        }
        function updateTasksAnalytics(tasks) {
            const list = Array.isArray(tasks) ? tasks : [];
            const pending = list.filter(t => t.status === 'Pending').length;
            const completed = list.filter(t => t.status === 'Completed').length;
            document.getElementById('statPendingTasks').textContent = pending;
            document.getElementById('statCompletedTasks').textContent = completed;
        }
        function renderTasks() {
            const board = document.getElementById('tasksKanbanView');
            if (!board) return;
            const list = Array.isArray(tasksCache) ? tasksCache : [];
            board.innerHTML = TASK_STAGES.map(stage => {
                const items = list.filter(t => t.status === stage);
                const cards = items.map(taskCard).join('') || '<div class="text-muted small px-1">—</div>';
                return `
                    <div class="kanban-col" data-stage="${stage}" ondragover="onTasksDragOver(event)" ondragleave="onTasksDragLeave(event)" ondrop="onTasksDrop(event, '${stage}')">
                        <div class="kanban-col-header"><span>${stage}</span><span class="badge bg-dark">${items.length}</span></div>
                        <div class="kanban-col-body">${cards}</div>
                        <div class="text-muted small mt-2">รวม: ${items.length}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        function taskCard(t) {
            const options = TASK_STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === t.status ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');
            return `
                <div class="kanban-card" draggable="true" data-task-id="${t.id}" ondragstart="onTasksDragStart(event, ${t.id})" ondragend="onTasksDragEnd(event)">
                    <div class="fw-semibold">${fmt(t.title)}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">${fmt(t.description)}</div>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm kanban-stage-select mt-2" onchange="changeTaskStatus(${t.id}, this.value)">${options}</select>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        function onTasksDragStart(e, id) {
            draggedTaskId = id;
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(id));
        }
        function onTasksDragEnd(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-col.drag-over').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
        }
        function onTasksDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
        }
        function onTasksDragLeave(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
        async function onTasksDrop(e, stage) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
            let id = draggedTaskId;
            if (id === null || id === undefined) {
                const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
                id = raw ? Number(raw) : NaN;
            }
            draggedTaskId = null;
            if (!id) return;
            await changeTaskStatus(id, stage);
        }
        async function changeTaskStatus(id, status) {
            if (!TASK_STAGES.includes(status)) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${id}/status`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ status })
                });
                if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('อัปเดต Status สำเร็จ'); }
                else { toastError('อัปเดต Status ไม่สำเร็จ'); }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('changeTaskStatus Error:', e);
                toastError('อัปเดต Status ไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
            loadTasks();
        }
        // ===== Tasks Filters (Assigned To / Due date range) + Export CSV =====
        let tasksFilter = { assignedTo: '', from: '', to: '' };
        function populateTasksAssignedToFilter(assignedTo) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilter');
            if (!sel) return;
            const current = sel.value;
            const opts = ['<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>'].concat(
                (assignedTo || []).map(a => `<option value="${a}">${fmt(a)}</option>`)
            );
            sel.innerHTML = opts.join('');
            if (current) sel.value = current;
        }
        function filteredTasks() {
            return tasksCache.filter(t => {
                if (tasksFilter.assignedTo !== '' && String(t.assigned_to) !== String(tasksFilter.assignedTo)) return false;
                if (tasksFilter.from && (!t.due_date || String(t.due_date).slice(0, 10) < tasksFilter.from)) return false;
                if (tasksFilter.to && (!t.due_date || String(t.due_date).slice(0, 10) > tasksFilter.to)) return false;
                return true;
            });
        }
        function applyTasksFilters() {
            tasksFilter.assignedTo = document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilter').value;
            tasksFilter.from = document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilterFrom').value;
            tasksFilter.to = document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilterTo').value;
            renderTasks();
        }
        function resetTasksFilters() {
            document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilter').value = '';
            document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilterFrom').value = '';
            document.getElementById('tasksAssignedToFilterTo').value = '';
            applyTasksFilters();
        }
        function renderTasks() {
            const list = filteredTasks();
            updateTasksAnalytics(list);
            if (tasksView === 'kanban') renderTasks();
            const tbody = document.getElementById('tasksTable');
            if (!tbody) return;
            tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                <tr>
                    <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.title)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.description)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.due_date)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.assigned_to)}</td>
                    <td>${fmt(item.status)}</td>
                    <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteTask(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }
        function exportTasksPipeline() {
            const list = filteredTasks();
            if (!list.length) { toastError('ไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับ export'); return; }
            const headers = ['ID', 'Title', 'Description', 'Due Date', 'Assigned To', 'Status'];
            const esc = (v) => '"' + ((v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v)).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
            const rows = list.map(t => [t.id, t.title, t.description, t.due_date, t.assigned_to, t.status].map(esc).join(','));
            const csv = [headers.map(esc).join(',')].concat(rows).join('\r\n');
            const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = 'tasks-pipeline-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            toastSuccess('Export pipeline สำเร็จ');
        }
    </script>
</body>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadAccounts();
            loadContacts();
            loadProducts();
            loadDeals();
            loadLeads();
        });

        // แสดงผลค่า null / undefined เป็นเครื่องหมาย -
        const fmt = (val) => (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') ? '-' : val;

        // SweetAlert2 helpers (toast + confirm)
        const toast = Swal.mixin({
            toast: true,
            position: 'top-end',
            showConfirmButton: false,
            timer: 1600,
            timerProgressBar: true,
        });
        const toastSuccess = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title });
        const toastError = (title) => toast.fire({ icon: 'error', title });

        async function confirmDelete() {
            const { isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
                title: 'คุณต้องการลบข้อมูลนี้ใช่หรือไม่?',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: 'ยืนยัน',
                cancelButtonText: 'ยกเลิก',
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                cancelButtonColor: '#6c757d',
                reverseButtons: true,
            });
            return isConfirmed;
        }

        async function loadAccounts() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/accounts');
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.data || []);
                populateDealAccountFilter(list);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('accountsTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${fmt(item.id)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.name)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.industry)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.phone)}</td>
                        <td>${fmt(item.website)}</td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteAccount(${item.id})">Delete</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (e) { console.error('loadAccounts Error:', e); }
        }

        // ===== Deals Pipeline (Sales Analytics + Kanban Board) =====
        const DEAL_STAGES = ['Prospecting', 'Qualification', 'Proposal', 'Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'];
        let dealsView = 'table';
        let dealsCache = [];
        let draggedDealId = null;

        function setDealsView(view) {
            dealsView = view;
            document.getElementById('dealsTableView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanView').classList.toggle('d-none', view !== 'kanban');
            document.getElementById('dealsTableViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'table');
            document.getElementById('dealsKanbanViewBtn').classList.toggle('active', view === 'kanban');
            if (view === 'kanban') renderKanban(filteredDeals());
        }

        function updateDealsAnalytics(deals) {
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            const total = list.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
            const won = list.filter(d => d.stage === 'Closed Won').length;
            const winRate = list.length ? (won / list.length) * 100 : 0;
            document.getElementById('statTotalAmount').textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            document.getElementById('statWinRate').textContent = winRate.toFixed(1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('statDealCount').textContent = list.length;
        }

        function renderKanban(deals) {
            const board = document.getElementById('kanbanBoard');
            if (!board) return;
            const list = Array.isArray(deals) ? deals : [];
            board.innerHTML = DEAL_STAGES.map(stage => {
                const items = list.filter(d => d.stage === stage);
                const sum = items.reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.amount) || 0), 0);
                const cards = items.map(kanbanCard).join('') || '<div class="text-muted small px-1">—</div>';
                return `
                    <div class="kanban-col" data-stage="${stage}" ondragover="onKanbanDragOver(event)" ondragleave="onKanbanDragLeave(event)" ondrop="onKanbanDrop(event, '${stage}')">
                        <div class="kanban-col-header"><span>${stage}</span><span class="badge bg-dark">${items.length}</span></div>
                        <div class="kanban-col-body">${cards}</div>
                        <div class="text-muted small mt-2">รวม: ${sum.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function kanbanCard(d) {
            const amount = (d.amount === null || d.amount === undefined) ? '-' : Number(d.amount).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            const options = DEAL_STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === d.stage ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');
            return `
                <div class="kanban-card" draggable="true" data-deal-id="${d.id}" ondragstart="onKanbanDragStart(event, ${d.id})" ondragend="onKanbanDragEnd(event)">
                    <div class="fw-semibold">${fmt(d.title)}</div>
                    <div class="deal-amount">${amount}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">#${d.id} • ปิด: ${fmt(d.close_date)}</div>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm kanban-stage-select mt-2" onchange="changeDealStage(${d.id}, this.value)">${options}</select>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function onKanbanDragStart(e, id) {
            draggedDealId = id;
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(id));
        }
        function onKanbanDragEnd(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-col.drag-over').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
        }
        function onKanbanDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
        }
        function onKanbanDragLeave(e) {
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
        async function onKanbanDrop(e, stage) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
            let id = draggedDealId;
            if (id === null || id === undefined) {
                const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
                id = raw ? Number(raw) : NaN;
            }
            draggedDealId = null;
            if (!id) return;
            await changeDealStage(id, stage);
        }

        async function changeDealStage(id, stage) {
            if (!DEAL_STAGES.includes(stage)) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/deals/${id}/stage`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ stage })
                });
                if (res.ok) { toastSuccess('อัปเดต Stage สำเร็จ'); }
                else { toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ'); }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('changeDealStage Error:', e);
                toastError('อัปเดต Stage ไม่สำเร็จ');
            }
            loadDeals();
        }

        // ===== Deals Filters (Account / Close date range) + Export CSV =====
        let dealsFilter = { account: '', from: '', to: '' };

        function populateDealAccountFilter(accounts) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount');
            if (!sel) return;
            const current = sel.value;
            const opts = ['<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>'].concat(
                (accounts || []).map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${fmt(a.name)} (#${a.id})</option>`)
            );
            sel.innerHTML = opts.join('');
            if (current) sel.value = current;
        }

        function filteredDeals() {
            return dealsCache.filter(d => {
                if (dealsFilter.account !== '' && String(d.account_id) !== String(dealsFilter.account)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.from && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) < dealsFilter.from)) return false;
                if (dealsFilter.to && (!d.close_date || String(d.close_date).slice(0, 10) > dealsFilter.to)) return false;
                return true;
            });
        }

        function applyDealFilters() {
            dealsFilter.account = document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value;
            dealsFilter.from = document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value;
            dealsFilter.to = document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value;
            renderDeals();
        }

        function resetDealFilters() {
            document.getElementById('dealFilterAccount').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterFrom').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dealFilterTo').value = '';
            applyDealFilters();
        }

                <div id="dealsKanbanView" class="d-none">
                    <div class="text-muted small mb-2">ลากการ์ดเพื่อย้าย Stage หรือเลือก Stage จาก dropdown บนการ์ดได้เลย</div>
                    <div class="kanban-board" id="kanbanBoard"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="modal fade" id="addDealModal" tabindex="-1">

                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="addDealForm">
                        <div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label">Title *</label><input type="text" class="form-control" id="dealTitle" required></div>

                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Stage *</label>
                            <select class="form-select" id="dealStage" required>
                                <option value="Prospecting">Prospecting</option>
                                <option value="Qualification">Qualification</option>
                                <option value="Proposal">Proposal</option>
                                <option value="Closed Won">Closed Won</option>
                                <option value="Closed Lost">Closed Lost</option>
                            </select>
